guards: ported candidate requires the exact command followed by whitespace

constraints: guild member removal is normalized to one relation delete
operations idempotency scope and key unique
database.transactionBoundary: lock master operator identity and target membership/guild, protect leader role, delete one guild_members row, then write operation, execution, audit and reply outbox atomically

trialMigration.sourceSnapshot: synthetic relational admin, guild and membership fixture
trialMigration.replayPolicy: same event id returns the prior result without a second membership delete or outbox

fixtures: in-memory master, ordinary operator, leader and ordinary target cases
synthetic MariaDB super-admin and ordinary guild member
parity.comparisonMode: exact guard/error/success reply and membership deletion order

shadow.mode: three-command isolated synthetic MariaDB rehearsal; no operational snapshot or live-room traffic
observations: ordinary synthetic member relation was removed once
same event returned the identical result after MariaDB restart
operation, execution, audit and outbox each remained one

cutover.freezePlan: Stop legacy membership writes during approved guild cutover
cutover.finalImportPlan: Import latest guild memberships and operator grants after backup
cutover.smokePlan: Expel an approved ordinary test member and verify membership/reply/audit
cutover.rollbackPlan: Keep Rhino path active until DB smoke passes; restore backup and disable DB dispatch on failure

risks: legacy isMaster also depends on permitted room; adapter must preserve operator grant and channel scope
operational snapshots were read only and were not modified
